items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: you've Corea's done some wonderful things with Chick Currea's compositions

ctx.x: of what I would hope to be good taste.

Now, in recent years, capped by the first Chick, Donald, Walter, and side of your current album, (unintelligible) Woodrow, you've Corea's done some wonderful things with Chick Currea's compositions. And that seems to have maybe even widened your audience, do you feel that?

Oh, yeah, I want to do -- I would like to be able to continue to do more and more of this, with different composers and different people, people who had a broader view. And I feel still haven't made any musical concessions, to any great degree.
